items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: And my sister Louise, who is the middle sister, was very proficient at playing the piano

ctx.x: My talent I would say came directly from my mother and father. Everybody in my family was

musically inclined. Every, every child in the family was musically inclined. As I said I know very little about my brother, but all three of my sisters who are living now sing, well. And my sister Louise, who is the middle sister, was very proficient at playing the piano until she had an operation on her fingers.

So I would have to say that most of my musical start came from my mother and father. My mother, I understand, used to hold me in her lap while she played the piano. My father played enough piano to realize or have someone realize that he knew where the notes were. He didn't concentrate on playing the piano because my mother was very good playing the piano. Both of my mothers, my real mother and my step mother. I knew nothing about my real mother except having seen her in the hospital on her dying day and seeing…
